Class FocusManager

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.focus.FocusManager
public final class FocusManager extends Object
Manages focus state for focusable elements. Handles tab navigation and click-to-focus.

    • registerFocusable

      public void registerFocusable(String elementId, Rect area)
      Registers a focusable element with its rendered area. Called during rendering to track focusable elements.

      If nothing is currently focused, the first registered element will be auto-focused.

      Parameters:
      elementId - the element ID
      area - the rendered area

    • clearFocusables

      public void clearFocusables()
      Clears all registered focusable elements. Should be called at the start of each render cycle.
